summary.description: One or two plain-English sentences stating how many distinct problems this run's failures actually represent.

groups.description: Distinct root causes, most-explanatory first. Two scenarios failing for the same reason belong in ONE group.

title.description: A short label for this root cause, e.g. 'Login button locator is stale'.

rootCause.description: Two to four plain-English sentences explaining the likely cause. No jargon.

suggestedFix.description: One concrete, actionable next step that would clear every scenario in this group.

scenarioNames.description: Exactly the scenario names from the input that this root cause explains. Every input scenario must appear in exactly one group.

suggestedLocator.description: Only when the group clearly names a specific broken locator and you are confident about a replacement. Null otherwise.

page.description: Page object class name, e.g. LoginPage.
